newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Hewlett-Packard shrs fall.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Hewlett-Packard shrs fall.

text.p: Shares in Hewlett-Packard fell in after-hours trading, shedding 5/8 to 49-1/2, traders said.

The company, based in Palo Alto, Calif., posted its fourth-quarter earnings shortly after the market closed. Orders rose 15 percent during the quarter but net income fell to $0.62 per share compared to $0.64 per share.
The First Call consensus estimate for the quarter was $0.64 per share.
The company's shares were halted from after-hours trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
The NYSE said its session one volume was 231,600 shares compared with 289,100 shares on Friday. Session two volume was 237,300 shares compared with Friday's volume of 2,164,432 shares.
The American Stock Exchange said it had no after-hours activity.
